CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, June 17, 2026 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Justin Love, Commission Member
  Britney Navarro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE MAY 20, 2026 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS

  V.  PUBLIC ART PROPOSAL: 110 SOUTH CHAPEL AVENUE

 VI.  STAFF REPORT

VII.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VIII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 IX.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until approved by the  June 17, 2026
Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, May 20, 2026
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:01 P.M. on Wednesday May 20, 2026 in Conference Room “A” at Alhambra City Hall, 111
South First Street Alhambra, 91801.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Hermano, and Commission Member Navarro.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Love.
Staff Present: Deputy Director Houghton, Recreation Supervisor Boettcher, and Clerical
Assistant II Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF THE APRIL 15, 2026 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING MINUTES
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second from Commission Member Hermano
the April 15, 2026 minutes were approved as written.

ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS
The Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission discussed kinetic sculptures and peace
poles as potential Alhambra Community Center public art features. As requested by Deputy
Director Houghton, the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission will provide two
quotes for recommended Alhambra Community Center public art features for discussion at the
next scheduled meeting.

PUBLIC ART PROPOSAL: 110 SOUTH CHAPEL AVENUE, TAG DESIGN WORKS
The Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission deferred the proposal’s final
determination until the designers provide further clarification.

STAFF REPORT
Deputy Director Houghton presented the 2027 Alhambra Tournament of Roses final float
rendering to the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission and requested each
commissioner to provide three float titles for discussion at the next scheduled meeting.

Recreation Supervisor Boettcher shared a contest application titled, “Faces of Welcome”, that
will be open for a four-week public nomination period in Summer 2026 for outstanding adult
Alhambra residents that demonstrate a positive community impact in one of the following
categories: Welcome Across Cultures, Heart of Welcome, Welcome in Education, Business of
Welcome, and Welcome through Service. Selected residents will ride on the 2027 Alhambra
Tournament of Roses float.
 Recreation Supervisor Boettcher invited the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events
commission and their families to attend the Memorial Day event on Monday May 25, 2026 at
Alhambra Park.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
No public communication requests received.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
President Canseco thanked the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission for his
2026-2027 term reappointment.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Vice President Saunders and a second by Commission Member Navarro, the
May 20, 2026 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:44 P.M.
